In accordance with and pursuant to the Rules and Regulations of the Public Employment Relations Board of the State of California, the San Francisco Unified School District recognizes the United Educators of San Francisco, AFT Local 61, AFL-CIO, NEA/CTA, as the exclusive representative as defined in Government Code, Sections 3540 through 3549.3, also known as the Educational Employment Relations Act.

The Union and its members shall have the right to make use of school buildings and facilities pursuant to the provisions of the Civic Center Act.
meta_state_law_citations_007.evidence: Government Code, Sections 3540 through 3549.3; Civic Center Act
